```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)

clean_meta_str <- function(x, default = "") {
  if (length(x) == 0L || is.null(x)) return(default)
  if (length(x) != 1L) x <- x[[1L]]
  if (is.na(x)) return(default)
  val <- trimws(as.character(x))
  if (!nzchar(val)) default else val
}

stopifnot(nchar(params$data_rds) > 0 && file.exists(params$data_rds))
report_data <- readRDS(params$data_rds)

domain <- report_data$domain
wave   <- report_data$wave
dims   <- report_data$dims
```

## 報告資訊

| 欄位 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 資料群組（Domain） | `r domain` |
| 波次 | `r wave` |
| 包含構面數 | `r length(dims)` |
| 產生時間 | `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")` |

---

```{r, results='asis'}
for (dim_info in dims) {
  dim_title <- clean_meta_str(dim_info$dimName,
                              default = clean_meta_str(dim_info$dimID))
  dim_raw   <- clean_meta_str(dim_info$dimNameRaw, default = dim_title)
  alias_txt <- clean_meta_str(dim_info$alias)
  # 構面標題
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", dim_title))
  if (nzchar(alias_txt) && dim_title != dim_raw) {
    cat(sprintf("*（原名：%s · alias: %s）*\n\n", dim_raw, alias_txt))
  }

  # 信度
  rel_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dim_info$reliability))
  if (!is.null(dim_info$reliability) && !is.na(rel_val)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<span class="reliability-badge">Cronbach\'s &alpha; = %.3f</span>\n\n',
      rel_val
    ))
  } else {
    cat('<span class="reliability-badge" style="background:#f5f5f5;color:#888;">信度待填</span>\n\n')
  }

  # 備註
  if (!is.null(dim_info$note) && nchar(trimws(as.character(dim_info$note))) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("**備註：** %s\n\n", dim_info$note))
  }

  # 題目表格
  items_df <- dim_info$items
  items_df$label <- str_replace_all(items_df$label, "\r?\n", " / ")
  
  print(knitr::kable(
    items_df[, c("itemID", "itemVer", "block", "label")],
    col.names = c("題項 ID", "版本", "問卷模組", "題目"),
    format    = "html",
    escape    = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-sm table-bordered table-hover"'
  ))

  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
}
```
